items.description: A historic college building associated with education in Botswana. It is a well-known legacy structure in Moeng.
Ruins of an old church at Old Palapye. The site is a visible reminder of the area's early settlement history.
A hilltop museum in Mochudi with strong local identity. It is a cultural landmark as well as a museum.
A mixed-use complex in Gaborone that combines offices, retail, and hotels. It is one of the city's modern urban landmarks.
A Hindu temple in Gaborone serving the city's Indian community. It is a distinctive religious landmark.
A museum in Francistown that stands as a cultural landmark for the north. It presents heritage and local memory.
A memorial site at Kolobeng linked to David Livingstone's mission work. It is a small but important historical landmark.
The main dam serving Gaborone is a major water-supply landmark. It plays a practical role in the capital's growth.
A well-known craft centre in Gaborone for handmade goods and local art. It supports the creative economy.
The Botswana Bureau of Standards building is tied to national quality control and industrial regulation. It is a visible institutional landmark in Gaborone.
A royal burial site in Serowe connected to the Bangwato leadership line. It is both a heritage place and a landmark.
A museum in Maun that serves as a cultural landmark for Ngamiland. It highlights local history and identity.
